T: Choose your character. Choose your snack.
D: Four teens in detention get sucked into a video game and become its avatars.
P: Serve dessert, carefully, when Mouse Finch learns his weakness is cake.
S: the four kids stuck in detention clearing out the basement
Salted pretzels, ridged potato chips and chocolate-coated peanuts tossed together in a big bowl, with a small bowl of mixed lollies, like the stash you'd smuggle into detention.
Chicken thigh skewers marinated in yoghurt, garlic, paprika and lemon, grilled hot, with a garlic yoghurt dip and flatbread.
Dr Smolder Bravestone in the jungle

Fresh mango, red onion, chilli and coriander with lime, scooped up with corn chips. Dice 2 mangoes and mix with half a diced red onion, 1 chopped chilli, a handful of coriander and the juice of 2 limes.
M: Rump steak marinated in garlic, chilli and lime, grilled over coals, sliced, with charred corn and a mango salsa.
a dinner in the jungle level
Red curry paste fried in thick coconut cream until fragrant, chicken thighs, coconut milk, bruised lemongrass, torn lime leaves, fish sauce and palm sugar, simmered 20 minutes. Jasmine rice.
W: Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked with eggs and sugar, flour folded in, baked in two tins at 170C for 30 minutes, layered and covered in glossy ganache. Eat with care.
K: Pineapple juice, mango nectar and fresh passionfruit pulp with a squeeze of lime, topped with soda water over crushed ice.

s.note: the four kids stuck in detention clearing out the basement
s.how: Toss a bag of ridged potato chips, 150g pretzels and 150g chocolate-coated peanuts together in a big bowl. Put 200g mixed lollies in a smaller bowl next to it, like a stash you'd smuggle into detention.

s.note: Dr Smolder Bravestone in the jungle
s.how: Dice 2 mangoes and mix with half a diced red onion, 1 chopped chilli, a handful of coriander and the juice of 2 limes. Season and serve with 230g corn chips.

m.note: a dinner in the jungle level
m.how: Fry 3 tbsp red curry paste in the thick top of 400ml coconut milk until fragrant. Add 800g sliced chicken thighs, the rest of the coconut milk, a bruised lemongrass stalk, torn lime leaves, fish sauce and palm sugar. Simmer 20 minutes. Serve with 300g jasmine rice.

w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 200g butter, whisk in 4 eggs and 200g sugar and fold in 150g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 170C for 30 minutes. Layer and cover with 150g chocolate melted with 150ml cream.

d.how: Mix 400ml pineapple juice, 400ml mango nectar, the pulp of 3 passionfruit and the juice of a lime. Pour over crushed ice in four glasses and top with soda water.
